_meta.description: Retail enterprise test suite for agent-skill-creator performance evaluation. Each test case maps to a specific pipeline phase and optimization dimension.

cases.name: 门店日报自动化
cases.description_zh: 每天都要做这个表，帮我自动化
cases.input_prompt: 每天都要做这个表，帮我自动化
cases.test_dimension: Phase 1 token waste when no API exists
critical_checks: skill must NOT contain references/api-guide.md (no API needed)
skill must parse 4 Excel sheets correctly
output must include human-readable daily summary
phase 1 should recognize file-only input and skip API search
anti_patterns: generates api-guide.md with public API recommendations
treats .xlsx as CSV (loses sheet structure)
outputs raw data table without summary

cases.name: 竞品价格监控（京东/天猫）
cases.description_zh: 帮我盯一下京东和天猫上我们同类产品的价格变化，每周出个对比表
cases.input_prompt: 帮我盯一下京东和天猫上我们同类产品的价格变化，每周出个对比表
cases.test_dimension: Phase 1 non-English API discovery and selection
critical_checks: Phase 1 must search for Chinese retail APIs (京东开放平台, 淘宝开放平台)
must identify that scraping is NOT the primary approach (APIs exist)
skill must include API auth instructions for Chinese platforms
must handle rate limits and anti-bot measures
anti_patterns: falls back to web scraping without checking APIs first
ignores Chinese retail ecosystem entirely (suggests Amazon API)
no API auth/rate limit documentation

cases.name: ERP与POS对账
cases.description_zh: 我们用的是金蝶K/3，每周从系统里导出一个CSV，然后跟门店的POS数据对账
cases.input_prompt: 我们用的是金蝶K/3，每周从系统里导出一个CSV，然后跟门店的POS数据对账
cases.test_dimension: Phase 1 'data already exists' check + two-source reconciliation
critical_checks: must detect that data is in local CSVs (no API needed)
must NOT search for Kingdee/JinDie API
must match records across two sources with fuzzy matching
must report mismatches clearly (missing in ERP, missing in POS, amount diff)
anti_patterns: searches for '金蝶 API' or 'Kingdee API'
generates api-guide.md
only does exact match (fails on date/time format differences)

cases.name: 促销ROI分析
cases.description_zh: 每次做完大促，老板都要看三个数：促销投入多少钱、带来多少增量销售、有没有吃掉正常销售。但我们现在是手工算的，经常算错
cases.input_prompt: 每次做完大促，老板都要看三个数：促销投入多少钱、带来多少增量销售、有没有吃掉正常销售。但我们现在是手工算的，经常算错
cases.test_dimension: Phase 2 analysis design precision for domain-specific math
critical_checks: must compute baseline sales (pre-promo average) correctly
must compute lift = (promo_sales - baseline) / baseline
must estimate cannibalization from post-promo dip
must compute ROI = (incremental_profit - marketing_cost) / marketing_cost
eval golden cases must include: zero lift, negative ROI, missing baseline period
anti_patterns: simplifies ROI to (promo_sales / marketing_cost) without baseline subtraction
ignores post-promo cannibalization effect
no baseline logic (just compares two raw numbers)
eval cases only test happy path

cases.name: 商品汰换决策
cases.description_zh: 每个季度要决定哪些商品下架、哪些补货，现在凭感觉做，想做数据化一点
cases.input_prompt: 每个季度要决定哪些商品下架、哪些补货，现在凭感觉做，想做数据化一点
cases.test_dimension: Phase 2 handling of mixed quantitative/qualitative analysis
critical_checks: must produce a four-quadrant classification (high margin × high turnover etc.)
must NOT just output a sorted CSV — must include decision recommendations
must account for seasonality flag
must flag products with high returns rate for review
anti_patterns: sorts by sales volume and calls it 'optimization'
ignores margin/turnover trade-off
no actionable recommendations (just data dump)
treats seasonal products the same as non-seasonal

cases.name: 会员RFM分层
cases.description_zh: 我想把会员分成几类，比如高价值的、快流失的、沉睡的，然后针对每类做不同的营销
cases.input_prompt: 我想把会员分成几类，比如高价值的、快流失的、沉睡的，然后针对每类做不同的营销
cases.test_dimension: Phase 2 correct parameterization of standard methods
critical_checks: must compute Recency (days since last purchase), Frequency, Monetary correctly
must provide configurable scoring method (quantile vs fixed thresholds)
must produce segment profiles with actionable marketing recommendations
must handle members with zero/few transactions gracefully
anti_patterns: hardcodes bin thresholds (should be configurable or auto-computed)
uses arbitrary percentile cutoffs without explanation
no segment-specific recommendations
crashes on members with single transaction

cases.name: 月度经营分析（多维度suite）
cases.description_zh: 每个月要给区域经理做一套分析：销售达标率、库存健康度、人员效率、费用控制，四个维度，每个维度下面又有好几个子项
cases.input_prompt: 每个月要给区域经理做一套分析：销售达标率、库存健康度、人员效率、费用控制，四个维度，每个维度下面又有好几个子项
cases.test_dimension: Phase 3 correct classification as complex suite vs single skill
critical_checks: must be structured as a SUITE with 4+ component skills, not one giant SKILL.md
each component must have its own SKILL.md under suite root
must include a master orchestrator that runs all 4 and produces combined report
each sub-analysis must be independently usable
anti_patterns: crams all 4 dimensions into single SKILL.md > 500 lines
sub-analyses are not independently invocable
no combined executive summary across all dimensions

cases.name: 单店排班优化
cases.description_zh: 我家店长每周要排班，根据客流高峰低谷来安排人，帮我把这个做成一个工具
cases.input_prompt: 我家店长每周要排班，根据客流高峰低谷来安排人，帮我把这个做成一个工具
cases.test_dimension: Phase 3 correctly keeping simple task as simple skill
critical_checks: must stay as simple skill (not suite) — it's one pipeline
must generate weekly shift table from traffic data
must respect peak/off-peak staffing ratios
output must be a readable schedule table
anti_patterns: over-engineers into suite with separate traffic-analyzer, shift-generator, validator skills
SKILL.md exceeds 500 lines for a ~300 line problem
generates complex optimization algorithms when simple rule-based suffices

cases.name: 动销率分析（中文行业术语）
cases.description_zh: 给我做一个动销率分析的工具
cases.input_prompt: 给我做一个动销率分析的工具
cases.test_dimension: Phase 4 keyword/description accuracy for Chinese domain terms
critical_checks: description must include Chinese retail terms: 动销率, 滞销, SKU
keywords must cover both Chinese and English variants
must correctly compute sell-through = sold / (begin + end) / 2
must flag slow/dead SKUs with actionable thresholds
anti_patterns: description uses only English terms (misses 动销率 entirely)
computes sell-through incorrectly as sold/beginning
hardcodes English-only trigger keywords

cases.name: 退换货（极简输入）
critical_checks: must activate Phase 0 spec ideation (single word is too vague for Phase 1)
must present hypothesis: 'You need returns rate analysis, reason classification, refund tracking, and product quality alerts. Right?'
must NOT guess one narrow direction and build immediately
anti_patterns: jumps directly to Phase 1 without confirming interpretation
builds a skill for only one aspect (e.g., only refund tracking)
doesn't present hypothesis for user confirmation

cases.name: 薪资核算（安全敏感）
cases.description_zh: 我们门店员工的工资是按基本工资+提成+全勤+加班算的，提成规则每个品类不一样。帮我做一个核算工具
cases.input_prompt: 我们门店员工的工资是按基本工资+提成+全勤+加班算的，提成规则每个品类不一样。帮我做一个核算工具
cases.test_dimension: Phase 5 security scan + complex business rules + edge cases
critical_checks: security_scan must pass with zero high-severity findings
output files must NOT contain plaintext salary data without permission warnings
must parse commission_rules.md and implement tiered rules correctly
must handle: overtime across midnight, partial attendance, holiday pay multipliers
must compute social insurance deductions correctly
anti_patterns: hardcodes commission rules instead of reading from rules file
outputs .xlsx with salaries without any data protection note
logs salary values to stdout
eval cases don't cover boundary: zero sales, negative returns, max overtime

cases.name: 多格式门店周报
cases.description_zh: 每周要生成一份门店周报，给店长发PDF、给区域经理发表格、给总部发一页摘要。数据来自三个不同的导出文件
cases.input_prompt: 每周要生成一份门店周报，给店长发PDF、给区域经理发表格、给总部发一页摘要。数据来自三个不同的导出文件
cases.test_dimension: Phase 5 output quality: human-readable summary vs raw data dump
critical_checks: report.md MUST start with executive summary (本周结论), not a data table
must produce 3 differentiated outputs for 3 audiences (店长/区域经理/总部)
must merge data from 3 CSV sources correctly
summary text must be rule-generated (not LLM-dependent) for reproducibility
stdout after --report must print human-readable summary, not JSON dump
anti_patterns: report starts with KPI data table (CRM issue #2 pattern)
all three audience outputs are the same content with different file extension
summary requires LLM call (not reproducible)
pipeline stdout prints raw JSON
